subject.title: fix embedded compaction hook reset API

question: Should `PluginHookAgentContext.api.resetSession(reason?)` become the supported public contract for successful after-compaction hooks, with current-session-only targeting and lifecycle-deferred execution?
rationale: This adds a durable plugin capability whose availability, locking rules, result semantics, and ownership boundary cannot be finalized safely from implementation mechanics alone.

options.title: Approve narrow hook contract
options.body: Adopt the current-session, reason-only, after-compaction API after removing unrelated reset policy and completing lifecycle proof.

options.title: Keep reset internal
options.body: Withhold the public hook API and expose reset behavior only through an owner-controlled internal or plugin-specific lifecycle path.

recommendation.title: Approve narrow hook contract
recommendation.body: Adopt the current-session, reason-only, after-compaction API after removing unrelated reset policy and completing lifecycle proof.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the compaction hook surface whose public contract is being extended.
